title: The Message in the Foggy Window
skyStory: A sliver of waxing crescent returns at eight percent, still splashing around in Pisces like a kid who refuses to leave the pool. The moon is growing again, which means everything you planted on the new moon is quietly sprouting underground. Mars peers down, impatient. Saturn hands it a book called Waiting Well. Mars uses it as a coaster.

reading: The bathroom mirror will steam up this morning and practically beg you to write in it. So write in it. Something encouraging, something ridiculous, something for future-you to discover the next time the shower runs hot.

At work or wherever you are, a teammate will be struggling with a problem you solved once before. You will want to swoop in and fix it entirely. Instead, ask one good question and let them find the answer. Teaching is your Life Path 3 superpower, and watching someone else light up is a better reward than being the hero.
joel.mission: Write a short secret message in a steamy mirror or a frosted window for someone to discover later.
joel.omen: Fingerprints on glass in a heart or star shape. It means someone has been thinking warmly about you.

reading: The moon is growing, and so is something in you. You might not feel it yet. It is the quiet kind of growth, the kind that happens underground in February while the snow sits on top looking unimpressed.

Around 2:20 pm you will notice that a skill you have been practising is suddenly easier. Do not brush past it. Stop. Point at it like a birdwatcher spotting something rare. The [[Six of Swords]] is moving steadily across the water. Each little improvement is another oar stroke, and you are much further from the shore you left than you realise.
nancy.mission: Name out loud one thing you can do now that you could not do a year ago.
nancy.omen: A tiny green sprout or a houseplant with a new leaf. It means your effort is about to show.

together.text: Trade one small progress report each, something you are better at than last month. Then each pay the other one sincere, slightly over-the-top compliment about it. Saturn will roll its eyes. The moon will glow approximately one percent brighter.
